explorer.scope: Actual ODA saved-program execution; prepared GTEx/PGC summaries and synthetic oncoprint. No upstream study, AI/token benchmark or full GWAS preprocessing rerun.

initial_failed_attempt: The first test helper was named VERIFY and shadowed the SAS-supplied %VERIFY autocall used by %LEFT. The failed logs remain local. Only the test helper was renamed to a unique session-prefixed name; plotting programs were preserved and fresh sessions rerun.
cleanup_fix: Python inspected files before deleting them in a combined request. Both native CLIs now match Perl: download, delete, then final listing/metadata. Three offline regressions and a new live combined-operation probe in each repository passed. The follow-up independently verified all seven earlier inputs absent, downloaded a new file before deletion, preserved an unselected file, and cleaned all three new inputs. Original failed acceptance.json files remain unchanged; only this derived summary resolves the cleanup assertion. Graphics were not rerun after this file-operation-only fix.

limits: Four frozen PoC programs, not a full study/preprocessing/LD/GTF-download pipeline rerun.
Prepared GTEx/PGC summaries; oncoprint events are synthetic.
This live run used Windows/Cygwin and native Windows Python clients; the SAS execution host was ODA Linux.
SAS warnings were retained, not silently removed.
Concurrent elapsed times are observations, not a controlled runtime or cost benchmark.
The frozen forest plot has a very tight left variant-label margin. Successful execution does not certify publication layout.
